description: Defines constants, assertions, and the QuicConnectionMtuDiscoverer class for managing MTU discovery in QUIC protocol implementation.

classes.name: quic::QuicConnectionMtuDiscoverer
classes.description: A controller class for managing MTU discovery process in QUIC.

methods.name: QuicConnectionMtuDiscoverer
methods.description: Default constructor initializing in disabled state.

methods.name: QuicConnectionMtuDiscoverer
methods.description: Constructor with parameters for initial configuration.

methods.name: Enable
methods.description: Enables MTU discovery with specified max and target packet sizes.

methods.name: ShouldProbeMtu
methods.description: Determines if an MTU probe should be sent based on the largest sent packet.

methods.name: GetUpdatedMtuProbeSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the MTU probe packet before sending.

methods.name: OnMaxPacketLengthUpdated
methods.description: Updates internal state after max packet length change.

methods.name: packets_between_probes
methods.description: Returns the number of packets between MTU probes.

methods.name: next_probe_at
methods.description: Returns the packet number after which the next probe will be sent.

methods.name: operator<<
methods.description: Outputs the state of QuicConnectionMtuDiscoverer to a stream.
